text: ATOMIC™ 20V MAX* Right Angle Die Grinder (Tool Only)Skip to main contentDCG422BATOMIC™ 20V MAX* Right Angle Die Grinder (Tool Only)ReviewsExplore More OptionsCurrent OptionDCG422E2ATOMIC™ 20V MAX* Right Angle Die Grinder KitProduct detailsComplete high-powered applications in tight spaces with the ATOMIC™ 20V MAX* right angle die grinder (battery and charger sold separately) that delivers optimized maneuverability and up to 455 MWO. This tool is equipped with the DEWALT® perform and protect anti-rotation system to help maximize control. This feature quickly stops the wheel when a pinch, stall, or bind-up event is sensed, reducing reactionary torque. An ergonomic design allows this tool to access ultra tight spaces. Replace pneumatic die grinders with this cordless solution that delivers untethered performance, productivity, and pneumatic-like power†.Help Maximize Control - Equipped with the DEWALT® anti-rotation system. This feature quickly stops the wheel when a pinch, stall, or bind-up event is sensed, reducing reactionary torque. The switch needs to be cycled (turned on and off) to restart the tool.Electronic Brake - Help maintain control with the electronic brake designed to stop the wheel in less than 1 second* after the ON/OFF trigger is released.Ergonomic Design - Complete applications with a slim, ergonomic design and up to 22% more power than 0.5 HP rated pneumatic die grinders† for access into ultra tight spaces without sacrificing power.Compact Design - Access hard-to-reach areas with an equal gripping diameter to a low voltage cordless die grinder††Up to 53% More Power Than Milwaukee M12 Die Grinder‡ - Help maximize productivity and work fast with up to 53% more power than Milwaukee M12 die grinder‡.Variable Speed Trigger - Match speed to application to help optimize performance with variable speed up to 24,500 RPM (no-load).Easy Wheel Changes - Change wheels quickly with the spindle lock without the need for multiple wrenches.Brushless Motor Performance - Take on demanding applications with up to 455 MWO.Paddle Switch - Replicate the performance pneumatic tools with the lock off paddle and no-lock on feature.Forward Exhaust System - Direct air away from the user with an exhaust system that helps prevent overheating from the motor.Product TypeDie GrinderVoltage20VCordless or CordedCordlessPower SourceCordlessTool OnlyYes(1) DCG422 ATOMIC™ 20V MAX* Right Angle Die Grinder(1) 1/4 in.
